confirmation.source: published R8 named-calls/events plus original selected qbase
confirmation.check_confirm: no flag non-FALSE =>0; else yes flag non-FALSE=>1; else0
confirmation.wait_reset_order: WaitAndCheckConfirmMessage yields once before clearing yes/no; an earlier trigger can be lost
confirmation.on_yes_wire_scope: 004E -> F43DA named callback proved for MissionLobby4/Tutorial15, not arbitrary page
confirmation.on_no_native_caller: not closed in bounded reused evidence
confirmation.end_ack: Normal non-review, active, nonzero-quest End sends 003F only if converted CheckConfirmMessage is exactly 1. Normal active quest0 End and seen-skip can also send 003F without this confirmation gate; review and inactive paths differ. Talk completion alone is not confirmation or successful-run evidence.

shared_voice.replace: new valid resource can stop/replace prior channel; null new resource does not guarantee prior handle is cleared
shared_voice.release: voice_manager_tick clears handle when handle+0x24<=0 and backend absent or backend virtual+0x10 returns 0
shared_voice.content_policy: serialize or explicitly coordinate Dialogue/Prolog/Book/ScenarioTalk sharing this channel; do not infer audio result from unrelated UI state

server_development_requirements: Define story/session/quest admission and idempotent business result separately from Client presentation.
Validate selected scenario pair uniqueness, nonempty rows, all talk/actor/portrait/face resources, page and callback readiness before publish/start.
Keep world EntityId, Q slot, display actor key, talk key, Prolog idx and quest/scene selection keys in distinct schemas.
Assign confirmed, correlated decision input if choices or transactions are needed; OnEndTalk is not a choice and msg is not a proven option schema.
Keep HP/hit/kill/currency/inventory/quest rewards authoritative; display panels only present supplied results.
Define cancellation/timeouts/reentry and UI/audio ownership; release acquired state before Q.End as in the presentation package.
Handle original End003F conditions and world/scene acknowledgement separately; absence of ACK must not be interpreted as success.
exclusions: No claim that native .mef parser accepts general Lua
No native MapList/TRIGGER caller gap silently closed
No ordinary-world gameplay replacement or automatic server reward inferred
No dynamic execution, deployment, T01 FULL-PASS or RR ACCEPTED claim
